Name: Borderless Wood Floor Mod
Author: Digus
Description:
[size=3][b]Current [/b][/size][size=3][b]version: [/b]1.0.1[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Update to make it compatible with SMAPI 4
[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Objective: [/b][/size]
The original buildable floors always bothered me with their big borders, specially the wood floor. Just replacing the texture will not work since it try to place "corner border" on some configurations of floor. But now that understand more about how the game work I was able to code a fix to finally be able to replace the wood floor with a borderless version.

[size=3][b]Compatibility:[/b][/size]
This mod may conflict with other mods that change the wood floor.

[size=3][b]Installation:[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=2][url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4711/]Unzip the Borderless Wood Floor Mod[/url] into /Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size]
[*][size=2]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Uninstall:[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=2]Delete the mod from the installation folder.[/size]
[/list][size=3][b]
Special Thanks:[/b][/size][list]
[*] Everyone on the modding discord channel that are always super helpful.
[/list]
